skills.name: ytv-start
skills.description: Start or resume a ytvideos episode. Use for a new story/video request, an approved script, continuation, or a narrowly scoped edit; choose the channel and load the next task context.

skills.name: ytv-write-script
skills.description: Research, independently select a suitable topic, and write the complete approval-ready script for any ytvideos channel. Use for research and script tasks, factual checks, or script revisions.

skills.name: ytv-produce-video
skills.description: Produce an approved ytvideos script through storyboard, independent scene images, audio, subtitles and render. Use only the assigned task context and preserve exact accepted inputs.

skills.name: ytv-review-video
skills.description: Review the exact ytvideos MP4 and its artifacts, record measured and perceptual checks, repair scoped defects, and present the file for approval.

skills.name: ytv-release-video
skills.description: Prepare packaging and finish a fully populated scheduled YouTube release after exact MP4 approval. Use for metadata, thumbnails, captions, upload, scheduling and post-publication checks.

skills.name: ytv-operate
skills.description: Inspect or recover saved ytvideos runs, leases, blockers, uncertain external operations, worker capabilities, storage and budgets. Use for status, restart, cancellation and cleanup.

skills.name: ytv-maintain
skills.description: Change ytvideos code, profiles, documentation or project skills with bounded scope, contract tests and migration safeguards. Use for repository maintenance and onboarding a verified channel.
